name: infolder
label: Input Images
description: Input microscopy image folder for CIDeconvolve.

name: output_dir
label: Deconvolved Outputs
description: Output folder containing OME-TIFF, OME-Zarr, benchmark CSV, and montage results.

name: method
label: Deconvolution Method
description: Algorithm to use for deconvolution.

name: iterations
label: RL Iterations
description: Number of iterations per channel, comma-separated. A single value applies to all channels.

name: convergence
label: Convergence Mode
description: Early-stopping mode. Auto stops when relative change falls below the threshold; fixed runs all iterations.

name: rel_threshold
label: Convergence Threshold
description: Relative change threshold for early stopping when convergence is auto.

name: start
label: Initial Estimate
description: Initial estimate for iterative solvers.

name: microscope_type
label: Microscope Type
description: Microscope modality used for PSF generation.

name: na
label: Numerical Aperture
description: Objective numerical aperture, used as a fallback or override for PSF generation.

name: pinhole_airy
label: Confocal Pinhole (AU)
description: Confocal pinhole diameter in Airy disk units, comma-separated per channel. Use 0 for the legacy point-detector model.

name: refractive_index
label: Immersion Medium
description: Immersion medium refractive index preset.

name: sample_ri
label: Sample / Mounting Medium
description: Sample or mounting medium refractive index preset.

name: excitation_wl
label: Excitation Wavelengths (nm)
description: Excitation wavelengths in nanometers, comma-separated when the input has multiple channels.

name: emission_wl
label: Emission Wavelengths (nm)
description: Emission wavelengths in nanometers, comma-separated when the input has multiple channels.

name: pixel_size_xy
label: Pixel Size XY (nm)
description: Lateral pixel size in nanometers.

name: pixel_size_z
label: Pixel Size Z (nm)
description: Axial pixel size or Z step in nanometers.

name: overrule_image_metadata
label: Overrule Image Metadata
description: Use the supplied metadata values even when image metadata is present.

name: projection
label: Z Projection
description: Output a 2D Z projection instead of a full 3D stack. Ignored for 2D inputs.

name: output_format
label: Output Format
description: Output container for deconvolved data.

name: streaming
label: Large-Image Streaming
description: Use tile reads and direct OME-Zarr writes for large images.

name: streaming_threshold_gb
label: Streaming Threshold GB
description: Estimated full source array size above which streaming auto mode is enabled.

name: scene
label: Image Scene
description: Optional scene index or name for multi-scene images. Use auto for the default scene.

name: hcs_field
label: OME-Zarr HCS Field
description: Optional HCS field path such as A/1/0. Use auto for the first field.

name: benchmark
label: Benchmark Mode
description: Run benchmark mode on the first input image.

name: bench_crop
label: Benchmark Crop
description: Center-crop benchmark input to speed up comparison runs.

name: compute_metrics
label: Compute Image Metrics
description: Compute optional deconvolution-effect image metrics.

name: tv_lambda
label: TV Lambda
description: Total Variation regularization strength for ci_rl_tv.

name: sparse_hessian_weight
label: Sparse Hessian Weight
description: Hessian-vs-sparsity balance for ci_sparse_hessian.

name: sparse_hessian_reg
label: Sparse Hessian Reg
description: Data-vs-regularizer balance for ci_sparse_hessian.

name: device
label: Compute Device
description: Force compute device. Auto uses CUDA if available, otherwise CPU.

name: background
label: Background Subtraction
description: Background subtraction mode. Use auto, 0, or a numeric constant.

name: offset
label: Offset
description: Positive offset added during processing and removed afterwards. Use auto, none, 0, or a numeric value.

name: damping
label: Damping
description: Noise-gated damping for ci_rl and ci_rl_tv. Use none, auto, or a numeric value.

name: prefilter_sigma
label: Prefilter Sigma
description: Sigma in pixels for Anscombe-domain Gaussian prefiltering. Use 0 to disable.

name: two_d_mode
label: 2D Widefield Mode
description: 2D widefield deconvolution mode.

name: two_d_wf_aggressiveness
label: 2D WF Aggressiveness
description: Aggressiveness of 2D widefield auto deconvolution.

name: two_d_wf_bg_radius_um
label: 2D WF Background Radius (um)
description: Background estimator neighborhood radius in micrometers for 2D widefield auto mode.

name: two_d_wf_bg_scale
label: 2D WF Background Scale
description: Multiplier applied to the auto-estimated background in 2D widefield auto mode.
